items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: the great attorney, Mr. Don Pacheco that won the case for us

ctx.x: I remember there was -- I think I remember there were petitions going around, weren't there? Because I can remember signing some petitions.

Yeah. And a funny thing about it, we went to court and challenged the thing, and Bob Carr says, "Well, right now we can go in any one of these major hotels downtown and we can check in with our suitcase and take our bottle up to our room. We can call up the bellhop and order service and get our setups and whatnot." And says, "this is after 1:30, 2:00 o'clock in the morning, and we've got the same type of license. This is all we're doing." So we won on that account, here with the case in (unintelligible). We had a…

And we won the case, and I'll inject a little financial thing here. We were paying rent down to an agency here that owned a lot of buildings, Dikreau the building. It's called the Review Realty. He was renting us this place for his -- for $750.00 a month. We were playing -- paying $250.00 a month to the Rudensky Foundation for the use of the charter. That was $1,000.00 a month. And because of the fact that we couldn't sell whiskey, we had to charge for membership. We You could get a card for $5.00. First we…
